scientific_integrity: Exact finite-prufer-and-orientation computations supplement, but do not replace, the analytic proof. No independent mathematical audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Independent fair edge orientation on a uniform labeled Cayley tree only; no central limit theorem is claimed. Classical degree enumerators and published fixed-tree covariance identities are acknowledged as ingredients. Historical priority beyond inspected records remains unresolved.
title: Pairwise source–sink attraction and aggregate repulsion in uniformly oriented Cayley trees
